bio.text: Jim Walkowicz is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan's 9th Congressional District in the November 2026 election.

In 2022, when he also ran in the 9th District as a Working Class Party candidate, Michigan Public reported that he had recently retired from the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services and had been a union representative for 40 years.
Bridge Michigan reported in August 2024 that he was also the Working Class Party nominee in the 9th District that year and had run for the seat in 2022.
